test_custom_api_logging: test the async custom API logging callback feature using litellm success_callback set to generic
run_acompletion_with_generic_logger: run an async litellm completion with the generic logger endpoint configured via environment variable
configure_litellm_success_callback: configure litellm success callback to use generic API logging by setting success_callback to generic
set_litellm_verbose_mode: set litellm verbose mode to true for debugging API logging behavior during tests
test_litellm_retry_config: test litellm with num_retries set to 3 for handling transient API failures
